newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil gov't, states agree to cut taxes on exports.
newsitem.headline: Brazil gov't, states agree to cut taxes on exports.

text.p: The Brazilian government and representatives of the country's states have reached an agreement over a bill which would reduce taxes on exports and make industry more competitive, a minister said.

The agreement paves the way for the Chamber of Deputies to vote later on Tuesday on a motion giving the bill priority treatment in the lower house, Parlimentary Affairs Minister Luiz Carlos Santos told reporters.
Santos said a vote on the bill itself might yet take place on Tuesday. If not, the vote would be scheduled for Wednesday.

Analysts say that Brazil could boost exports by as much as four percent by exempting them from the so-called ICMS tax, as proposed in the bill. The new law would also exempt from ICMS goods and energy consumed in the manufacturing process.
